$$f(u) + f(T(u)) = g(u), \quad \text{where } g(u) = \frac{(1-n)(u^2 - 3u - 9)}{9nu} + \frac{2}{n}.$$

**Orbit structure of $T$.** Compute:
- $T(u) = \frac{9}{3-u}$
- $T^2(u) = T\!\left(\frac{9}{3-u}\right) = \frac{9}{3 - \frac{9}{3-u}} = \frac{9(3-u)}{3(3-u)-9} = \frac{9(3-u)}{-3u} = 3 - \frac{9}{u}$
